# Nick Powills

**Headline:** Author | Keynote Speaker | CEO of Mainland | 1851franchise.com | ESTATENVY | Room1903
**Current role:** CEO & Managing Partner
**Seniority:** C-Level, General Management
**Location:** Chicago, Illinois, United States
**Experience:** 25 years
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/powills · 14,587 followers
**Description:** Nick Powills is Founder and Chief Growth Officer of Mainland (www.hellomainland.com), a content marketing technology company; 1851 Franchise (www.1851franchise.com); and Good Spark (www.goodsparkfranchise.com). Nick is also the author of Sticks & Stones (www.stickstonesoar.com), an Inc. Magazine published book. He frequently keynotes conferences with a speech focused on leveraging your past pains to fuel a productive and choice driven future. Prior to starting No Limit (now Mainland) at the age of 27, Nick spent four years working at a franchise PR agency where he mastered the art of building rapport with media outlets and creating newsworthy pitches for earned media placements. Prior to jumping into PR, Nick worked as a writer at the Northwest Herald, a daily newspaper in Chicago; started Lumino, an online music magazine; and had internships at Rolling Stone and Details Magazine. He holds a Bachelor of Journalism from Drake University in Iowa. Specialties: Public Relations, Consumer Public Relations, Business Public Relations, Franchise PR, Consumer Social Media, Franchise Social Media, Public Relations; Franchising, Marketing; Social Media and Social Networking, Content Marketing
